授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: In this course, students will learn mathematics, physics, and how to write game programs. More specifically, students will learn the basics of geometry, vector operations, matrix operations, and geometric transformations as mathematics knowledge. Next, they will learn the basic equations of 1D, 2D, and 3D motion, Newton's law of motion. In parallel with learning mathematics and physics, students will also learn how to write programs.
advice: In this course, students will learn about mathematics, physics, and corresponding programs up to their application to game programs. Students will learn to solve exercises autonomously and explain the answers appropriately. In addition, students will acquire practical knowledge about familiar game programs through consideration of applications such as contribution to the information society.
requiredKnowledge: It is desirable for students to have taken basic mathematical courses.

              In this course, students will learn mathematics, physics, and how to write game programs. More specifically, students will learn the basics of geometry, vector operations, matrix operations, and geometric transformations as mathematics knowledge. Next, they will learn the basic equations of 1D, 2D, and 3D motion, Newton's law of motion. In parallel with learning mathematics and physics, students will also learn how to write programs.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In this course, students will learn about mathematics, physics, and corresponding programs up to their application to game programs. Students will learn to solve exercises autonomously and explain the answers appropriately. In addition, students will acquire practical knowledge about familiar game programs through consideration of applications such as contribution to the information society.
